column3: MT 51:1–3; the following verses of this psalm are MT +2. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts the last clause in parentheses. “Covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness,” and “wipe out” as “blot out.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wash me much” is rendered “Wash me thoroughly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pure” is rendered “blameless.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “truth,” and “in the covered places” as “in the innermost being.”
The Hebrew has futures, “You will purify … You will wash”; NASB renders them as imperatives.
Close to the Hebrew; “crushed” is rendered “broken.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the spirit of Your holiness” is rendered “Your Holy Spirit.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will return” is rendered “will be converted.”
Close to the Hebrew; “bloods” is rendered “bloodguiltiness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “You will open” is rendered “open.”
“And I will give” is rendered “otherwise I would give it.”
Close to the Hebrew; “crushed” is rendered “contrite.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will offer up” is rendered as a passive, “will be offered.”
